description: Add components, many per call, of any type: BUS (with latitude and longitude), GENERATOR, LOAD, STORAGE_UNIT, STORE, LINK, LINE, TRANSFORMER. Buses in the same call come first, so a build can add buses and what connects to them together. A carrier the model lacks is created. scenario "base" builds into the model itself (every scenario sees it); a scenario adds them off in the base and on there (a what-if). Values are static inputs, e.g. {"p_nom": 100, "max_hours": 4}; fill series (p_set, p_max_pu) with set_series after. The reply lists each one made, inputs refused, and inputs left at a default that leaves it idle. Values taken from a project file: give source {path, sheet, row} (on the call, or per component) and each is cited to it.

source.description: The project file the values came from.
